name: Skull-to-Face Matching Benchmark
description: A dataset and evaluation benchmark for matching skull images to corresponding facial photographs to study cross-domain identity representation.
evaluation_method: accuracy (identification / verification accuracy, often reported as top-1 identification rate)
reputation: A niche forensic research benchmark with limited adoption outside the forensic/biometrics research community.
notes: Small dataset and specialized domain (skull-to-face) with ethical/privacy concerns; significant cross-domain gap makes the task difficult; non-LLM benchmark; potential dataset bias and limited public samples.
